description.short_caption: Clinical photograph of the scrotum showing erythematous and thickened skin.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the scrotum with visible thickening of the skin, erythema, and irregular texture. There are small, scattered erythematous papules and areas of hyperpigmentation. The skin appears wrinkled and mildly inflamed, with no visible ulceration or discharge. The findings suggest a dermatologic or infectious process.

description.short_caption: Clinical photograph of the inguinal region showing localized swelling.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph depicts the inguinal region with a visible, localized swelling beneath the skin. The overlying skin appears slightly taut and may have a subtle bluish hue, suggesting underlying inflammation or fluid collection. No overt signs of ulceration, erythema, or drainage are visible in this image.
